additions.english: You will say: "If it is true that God does not like it, why does He sometimes answer?" I reply that sometimes the devil answers. But when God answers, I say it is because of the weakness of the soul, which wants to go along that path, so that it does not become discouraged and turn back, or so that it does not think that God is displeased with it, and thus be tempted too much, or for other ends that God knows are founded in the weakness of that soul, for which He sees that it is appropriate to answer and condescend along that path.
